decision.rationale: No mismatch yet recorded on initial-0 (both 0.3), initial-1 (left 0.6), initial-2 (right 0.6). Numerical fits for all families are staged with training RMSE ~0.083C near noise 0.08C and best BIC linear, so fitting alone cannot establish mechanism. Propose independent diagnostic sustained-both (60/60 sustained) to test initial model at higher joint heating not yet observed.
